Name: Stardew HRT
Author: aceynk
Description:
[size=5][b]Stardew HRT[/b][/size]

Happy Pride Month!! I hope you enjoy!!

[size=4][b]Dependencies[/b][/size]

Requires the following mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348[/url]﻿ (SpaceCore)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url]﻿ (Content Patcher)
[/list]
Requires SMAPI @ [url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io/[/url]

[size=4][b]Mod Info[/b][/size]

[b]Cocoyam Seeds[/b] are available at Joja and Pierre's shop during spring and summer.

[b]Cocoyam[/b] is a new vegetable, harvested from mature Cocoyam plants grown from Cocoyam Seeds.

[b]Progesterone[/b] is a new "Hormone" (Artisan Good), obtainable by placing a Cocoyam into an Oil Maker.

[b]Estrobench[/b] is a new Big Craftable. The item itself as well as the recipe is available at Harvey's shop.

[b]Testobench[/b] is a new Big Craftable. The item itself as well as the recipe is available at Harvey's shop.

[b]Estradiol[/b] is a new "Hormone" (Artisan Good), obtainable by placing Progesterone into an Estrobench.

[b]Testosterone[/b] is a new "Hormone" (Artisan Good), obtainable by placing Progesterone into a Testobench.

[b]Estradiol Pill[/b] is a new "Hormone" (Artisan Good), obtainable by placing Estradiol into a Dehydrator. Yields 5.

[b]Testosterone Pill[/b] is a new "Hormone" (Artisan Good), obtainable by placing Testosterone into a Dehydrator. Yields 5.

[b][size=4]Source[/size][/b]

The source is available at [url=https://github.com/aceynk/Stardew-HRT]https://github.com/aceynk/Stardew-HRT[/url], though nothing is objuscated within the download zip file, so the contents of it would work as an accurate source as well.
